headline: Financial Deepening Without Discipline
summary: The reported nonperforming-loan ratio rose from 20.2% at end-2024 to 30.6% at end-2025 as Bangladesh Bank tightened classification standards. The commentary says the losses accumulated over many years rather than a sudden deterioration.
why: Nonperforming loans measure bad debt in the banking system, and high ratios signal capital pressure and weaker credit quality for banks.
